lessons.title: Grandmother's Garden
lessons.context: A summer visit to the countryside.

paragraphs.tt: Җәй көне без әбиемә кунакка бардык.
paragraphs.en: In summer we went to visit my grandmother.

paragraphs.tt: Ул бакчасында кишер, кыяр һәм помидор үстерә.
paragraphs.en: She grows carrots, cucumbers and tomatoes in her garden.

paragraphs.tt: Без килгәч, ул безне тәмле бәлеш белән сыйлады.
paragraphs.en: When we arrived, she treated us to a tasty pie.

paragraphs.tt: Иртән мин аңа бакчада эшләргә булыштым.
paragraphs.en: In the morning I helped her work in the garden.

paragraphs.tt: Әгәр вакытым булса, мин аның янына еш кайтыр идем.
paragraphs.en: If I had the time, I would visit her often.

questions.question: What did she do when they arrived?
options: She met them at the station

questions.question: What would the narrator do with more time?

lessons.title: The Lost Wallet
lessons.context: A wallet left on a bus finds its way home.

paragraphs.tt: Узган атнада мин автобуста янчыгымны онытып калдырдым.
paragraphs.en: Last week I left my wallet on the bus.

paragraphs.tt: Өйгә кайткач кына моны аңладым.
paragraphs.en: I only realised it when I got home.

paragraphs.tt: Мин шунда ук автобус паркына шалтыраттым.
paragraphs.en: I phoned the bus depot straight away.

paragraphs.tt: Бер хатын янчыкны тапкан һәм аны шоферга биргән икән.
paragraphs.en: It turned out a woman had found the wallet and given it to the driver.

paragraphs.tt: Икенче көнне мин янчыгымны алдым һәм ул хатынга бик рәхмәтле булдым.
paragraphs.en: The next day I got my wallet back and was very grateful to that woman.

questions.question: Where did the narrator leave the wallet?

lessons.title: A New Job
lessons.context: A graduate's first steps at work.

paragraphs.tt: Абыем быел университетны тәмамлады.
paragraphs.en: My older brother graduated from university this year.

paragraphs.tt: Ул озак вакыт эш эзләде.
paragraphs.en: He looked for work for a long time.

paragraphs.tt: Ниһаять, аны бер зур компаниягә эшкә алдылар.
paragraphs.en: Finally a large company hired him.

paragraphs.tt: Беренче көнне ул бик дулкынланган иде, ләкин хезмәттәшләре аңа ярдәм иттеләр.
paragraphs.en: On the first day he was very nervous, but his colleagues helped him.

paragraphs.tt: Хәзер ул эшеннән бик канәгать.
paragraphs.en: Now he's very happy with his job.

questions.question: What did the brother do this year?
How long did he look for work?
How did he feel on the first day?

lessons.title: A Friend in Kazan
lessons.context: Showing a visitor around the city.

paragraphs.tt: Дустым Казанга беренче тапкыр килде.
paragraphs.en: My friend came to Kazan for the first time.

paragraphs.tt: Без аның белән Кремльне карадык һәм Кол Шәриф мәчетенә кердек.
paragraphs.en: We visited the Kremlin and went into the Qol Sharif Mosque.

paragraphs.tt: Кичен Бауман урамы буйлап йөрдек.
paragraphs.en: In the evening we walked along Bauman Street.

paragraphs.tt: Дустым татар ашларын беренче тапкыр татып карады, аңа өчпочмак бик ошады.
paragraphs.en: My friend tried Tatar food for the first time and really liked öçpoçmaq.

paragraphs.tt: Ул киләсе елда тагын килергә вәгъдә бирде.
paragraphs.en: He promised to come again next year.

questions.question: Had the friend been to Kazan before?
options: No, it was his first time

questions.question: Which building did they go into?

paragraphs.tt: Кичә көчле буран булды.
paragraphs.en: There was a strong blizzard yesterday.

paragraphs.tt: Юлларны кар каплаган иде, автобуслар йөрмәде.
paragraphs.en: Snow had covered the roads, and the buses weren't running.

paragraphs.tt: Шуңа күрә балалар мәктәпкә бармадылар.
paragraphs.en: So the children didn't go to school.

paragraphs.tt: Әтием иртә белән ишек алдындагы карны чистартты.
paragraphs.en: In the morning my father cleared the snow from the yard.

paragraphs.tt: Буран туктагач, без урамга чыгып кар бабай ясадык.
paragraphs.en: When the blizzard stopped, we went outside and made a snowman.

questions.question: Why didn't the children go to school?
options: The roads were covered with snow
The school was closed for repairs

questions.question: What did they do after the blizzard?

lessons.title: At the Library
lessons.context: A weekly visit to the library.

paragraphs.tt: Мин атнага бер тапкыр китапханәгә йөрим.
paragraphs.en: I go to the library once a week.

paragraphs.tt: Анда тыныч, һәм укырга бик уңайлы.
paragraphs.en: It's quiet there, and very comfortable for reading.

paragraphs.tt: Бүген мин Тукай шигырьләре китабын алдым.
paragraphs.en: Today I took out a book of Tukay's poems.

paragraphs.tt: Китапханәче миңа тагын бер кызыклы роман тәкъдим итте.
paragraphs.en: The librarian recommended another interesting novel to me.

paragraphs.tt: Мин аларны ике атна эчендә укып бетерергә тиеш.
paragraphs.en: I have to finish reading them within two weeks.

questions.question: How often does the narrator go to the library?
Whose poems did the narrator take?
How long can the books be kept?

paragraphs.tt: Узган шимбәдә апамның туе булды.
paragraphs.en: Last Saturday was my older sister's wedding.

paragraphs.tt: Туйга бик күп кунаклар килде.
paragraphs.en: Very many guests came to the wedding.

paragraphs.tt: Кунаклар яшьләргә бүләкләр бирделәр һәм аларны котладылар.
paragraphs.en: The guests gave the young couple presents and congratulated them.

paragraphs.tt: Музыка уйнады, кешеләр җырлады һәм биеде.
paragraphs.en: Music played, and people sang and danced.

paragraphs.tt: Туй төнге уникегә кадәр дәвам итте.
paragraphs.en: The wedding went on until midnight.

questions.question: Until when did the wedding last?

lessons.title: At the Gym
lessons.context: Advice from a doctor changes a routine.

paragraphs.tt: Табиб миңа күбрәк хәрәкәтләнергә кирәк дип әйтте.
paragraphs.en: The doctor told me I need to move more.

paragraphs.tt: Шуннан соң мин спорт залына йөри башладым.
paragraphs.en: After that I started going to the gym.

paragraphs.tt: Башта миңа бик авыр иде.
paragraphs.en: At first it was very hard for me.

paragraphs.tt: Хәзер мин атнага өч тапкыр шөгыльләнәм һәм үземне күпкә яхшырак хис итәм.
paragraphs.en: Now I train three times a week and feel much better.

paragraphs.tt: Әгәр син дә теләсәң, бергә йөри алабыз.
paragraphs.en: If you'd like to as well, we can go together.

questions.question: How often does the narrator train now?

lessons.title: Grandfather's Story
lessons.context: How a village boy became a teacher.

paragraphs.tt: Бабам яшь чагында авылда яшәгән.
paragraphs.en: When my grandfather was young, he lived in a village.

paragraphs.tt: Ул көн саен мәктәпкә биш чакрым җәяү йөргән.
paragraphs.en: Every day he walked five kilometres to school.

paragraphs.tt: Кышын юлларны кар каплый иде, ләкин ул беркайчан да дәресләрне калдырмаган.
paragraphs.en: In winter snow used to cover the roads, but he never missed a lesson.

paragraphs.tt: Соңрак ул укытучы булган һәм утыз ел балалар укыткан.
paragraphs.en: Later he became a teacher and taught children for thirty years.

paragraphs.tt: Мин аның хикәяләрен тыңларга бик яратам.
paragraphs.en: I love listening to his stories.

questions.question: Where did the grandfather live when young?
How far did he walk to school?

paragraphs.tt: Узган айда мин интернет аша яңа куртка сатып алдым.
paragraphs.en: Last month I bought a new jacket online.

paragraphs.tt: Куртка өч көннән соң килде.
paragraphs.en: The jacket arrived three days later.

paragraphs.tt: Ләкин мин аны кигәч, аның кечкенә икәнен аңладым.
paragraphs.en: But when I put it on, I realised it was too small.

paragraphs.tt: Мин аны кире кайтардым һәм зуррагын сорадым.
paragraphs.en: I sent it back and asked for a bigger one.

paragraphs.tt: Яңа куртка миңа бик туры килде.
paragraphs.en: The new jacket fitted me perfectly.

questions.question: How did the new one fit?
